# Bundled wedow/ticket

This directory vendors the canonical Bash implementation from
<https://github.com/wedow/ticket>, pinned to commit
`194b71a8bbc3771da1ce9f579395937c976bbddc`.

The executable is distributed as `tk` by `pi-tk-tickets`. Update it only by
reviewing and pinning a new upstream commit, replacing `tk` and this notice as
needed, and running the package smoke tests. Upstream is MIT licensed; see
[LICENSE](LICENSE).
